items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Rex came back with the band

ctx.x: And Roy and his brother was in the band. Actually, the band was really -- Fletcher and his little brother brought a band here from out of Columbus, Ohio, because all went to school at Wilberforce University, some of them did. And he brought a band here -- of course, Rex came back with the band.
You'd been to Wilberforce before Horace.
